description: Single source of truth for Town of Wiley custom AWS resources (account 570912405222). Frontend: S3 townofwiley-static-site + CloudFront E1NZ3XCY5CYR1J (Amplify Hosting d331voxr1fhoir deleted June 2026). Backend: Gen 1 AppSync j7b2x3sh7rcezekekkxxiak7hi + DynamoDB + Cognito us-east-2_DmY7BCBIp + S3 townofwiley-documents-storage-main. Integrations: NWS weather proxy, SES email alias router (us-east-1). Paystar: hosted portal URL only (no proxy Lambda). Resident billing/contact intake stack decommissioned June 2026 — see docs/contact-intake-decommission.md. CloudWatch: 1-day log retention + error alarms (no WAF). stephenmckitrick.com (CF E1VI8ZZ8L1HW1F) migrates to another account separately.

hosting.note: OAC active (E1UXALBLRIDL2E). Migrated from OAI on 2026-06-20 via scripts/migrate-cloudfront-oac.py.
hosting.deployCommand: npm run build && aws s3 sync dist/townofwiley-app/browser s3://townofwiley-static-site --delete --cache-control 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable' --exclude 'index.html' --exclude 'runtime-config.js' --exclude '*/*.html' && aws s3 sync dist/townofwiley-app/browser s3://townofwiley-static-site --delete --cache-control 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate' --include 'index.html' --include 'runtime-config.js' --include '*/*.html' && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E1NZ3XCY5CYR1J --paths "/*"

amplify.note: Amplify Hosting app d331voxr1fhoir DELETED June 2026. Gen 1 backend (amplify-townofwiley-main-d1245) remains production CMS. Gen 2/ampx path removed from repo June 2026.

syncScripts.note: amplify:sync-* scripts for hosting headers/buildspec are historical/dev-parity only (no-op for prod S3+CF; CSP at CloudFront Response Headers Policy)
syncScripts.headers: npm run amplify:sync-headers (CSP now at CF level via policy ID 22d4bac1...)
syncScripts.spaRules: npm run amplify:sync-spa-rewrites (now via CloudFront Function)

s3Buckets.name: townofwiley-documents-storage-main
s3Buckets.purpose: Amplify Storage branch bucket (logical name townofwiley-documents-storage)

s3Buckets.name: townofwiley-cf-logs
s3Buckets.purpose: CloudFront access logs for townofwiley.gov (lifecycle: expire after 30 days)

lambdaFunctions.notes: Handler-only CORS on Function URL (empty AllowOrigins); deploy script enforces
Resident severe weather alert signup (email + SMS)
SES-triggered; no Function URL; required for town email alias forwarding
Weekly SNS email when AppSync CMS API key expires within 30 days; reminder only (manual rotation)
Staff presigned S3 upload for CMS PDFs/images + CloudFront invalidation; Cognito Staff JWT
One-time scheduled deletion of retired AppSync CMS API keys after rotation bake-in
DynamoDB stream audit log + staff GET /recent; publishes cms-snapshot.json + cms-revision.json on public model changes
Community calendar public submit/list + email approve/reject + Cognito Staff JWT admin CRUD; run deploy script to set functionUrlEndpoint

opsObservability.notes: Optional SNS + S3 ops archive; site-monitor SES remains primary. Create topic/bucket once (IT); secrets optional in GitHub Actions.

decommissionedJune2026.note: Removed from AWS and manifest after cost review; code paths may remain in repo for reference until a follow-up PR strips UI.
other: WAF Web ACLs (TownOfWileyContactReviewApiRateLimit and Amplify Firewall)
Wiley Widget VPC wiley-co-aurora-vpc and interface endpoints
decommissionedJune2026.paystar: Hosted portal only per https://docs.paystar.io/api/query/ — PAYSTAR_PORTAL_URL in runtime-config; no API proxy Lambda
decommissionedJune2026.stephenmckitrick: CloudFront E1VI8ZZ8L1HW1F remains in this account until DNS/assets migrate to the other account (low-volume bill pay site)
